# Young Copper Dragon (`monsters:young-copper-dragon`)
*Large dragon, chaotic good* | **CR** 7 (XP 2,900; PB +3)
**AC** 17 | **HP** 119 (14d10 + 42) | **Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 80 ft.
**STR** 19 (+4) | **DEX** 12 (+1) | **CON** 17 (+3) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 13 (+1) | **CHA** 15 (+2)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +4, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +4
**Skills:** [Skill: Deception](../proficiencies/skill-deception.md) +5, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +7, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +4
**Damage Immunities:** acid
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 17
**Languages:** Common, Draconic

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slowing Breath.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
- **Acid Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 40 (9d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
- **Slowing Breath.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target can’t take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
